title: DL-029 Root Cause Analysis — Forward-Scan False Positive Mechanism
root_cause: CorrectChoice appears BEFORE QuestionID in all 5 pack files (universal pattern). Any scanner that finds QuestionID then searches FORWARD for CorrectChoice captures the NEXT QID's answer letter. With 4 answer choices distributed ~25% each, ~75% of adjacent QID pairs have different CC letters, producing massive false-positive rates on DL-008, DL-026, and other structural scans.

forward_scan_simulation.mechanism: Scanner extracts QuestionID at position P → searches forward for 'CorrectChoice' → finds the NEXT QID's CC at P+N. Since CC is always BEFORE QID in the object, the CC at P+N belongs to QID+1, not QID.

permanent_prevention_rules.rule: Function-constructor parse is the ONLY authoritative method for pack-file structural analysis
permanent_prevention_rules.detail: Parse pack files to actual JavaScript objects via Function constructor (not JSON.parse due to trailing commas). Extract CorrectChoice and all ExplanationWrong[A-D] fields from the exact same object. This is immune to field-ordering, cross-QID artifacts, and brace-matching errors.
permanent_prevention_rules.enforcement: Must be used for any scan that reports defect counts. Regex-based scans are acceptable for discovery/pattern-finding only — never for counting.

permanent_prevention_rules.rule: NEVER use forward-scan from QuestionID to find CorrectChoice
permanent_prevention_rules.detail: In all 5 pack files, CorrectChoice precedes QuestionID in the JSON object. A forward-scan from QuestionID captures the next QID's answer letter with ~75% false-positive rate.
permanent_prevention_rules.enforcement: Any structural scan script that uses forward-scan from QuestionID must be rejected at code review. Acceptable alternatives: reverse-scan (CC backward to QID), within-object brace extraction, or Function-constructor parse.

permanent_prevention_rules.rule: Verify CC position relative to QID before selecting any scan methodology
permanent_prevention_rules.detail: Before running any structural scan on a pack file, determine whether CorrectChoice appears before or after QuestionID in the JSON object. This one-time check prevents methodology selection errors.
permanent_prevention_rules.enforcement: Required as a precondition checklist item in any scanning agent's prompt or script header.

permanent_prevention_rules.rule: Every structural scan must self-verify against a ground-truth sample
permanent_prevention_rules.detail: Pick 5-10 QuestionIDs, manually extract CorrectChoice and ExplanationWrong from the source file by direct line-level inspection, and compare against the scan's output. If the scan mismatches on any sample item, the methodology is broken and results must be discarded.
permanent_prevention_rules.enforcement: Mandatory step in any scan workflow. Scan results are invalid until self-verification passes with 100% accuracy on the ground-truth sample.

permanent_prevention_rules.rule: All scanning scripts must be CC-position-aware
permanent_prevention_rules.detail: Scripts must determine whether CC precedes or follows QID in the pack's JSON object format and adapt extraction logic accordingly. Hardcoded 'forward from QID' logic is a defect.
permanent_prevention_rules.enforcement: Any scan script that hardcodes forward-scan from QuestionID is non-compliant. Scripts must include a position-detection preamble.

permanent_prevention_rules.rule: Totals-only reports without QID lists are rejected (per AGENTS.md §5)
permanent_prevention_rules.detail: Scan reports that produce a count without listing every flagged QID are unverifiable. Multiple prior sessions accepted conflicting totals (342 vs 112 vs 128 vs 67) without QID lists, making discrepancy resolution impossible.
permanent_prevention_rules.enforcement: Every scan output must include the full QID list for every flagged item. Counts must be reproducible by independent verification.

permanent_prevention_rules.detail: Any brace-matching or object-boundary extraction must track inString/stringChar/escape flags. Brackets inside JSON string values (common in stems, explanations, choices) cause naive brace-counters to misidentify object boundaries, producing undercounts or corrupted objects.
permanent_prevention_rules.enforcement: String-aware parsing is a prerequisite for any object-boundary extraction method. Reference implementation: scripts/parse_pack_b.js pattern.

permanent_prevention_rules.rule: Two independent scans must converge before accepting any count (per AGENTS.md §6)
permanent_prevention_rules.detail: Count instability (DL-012: 128→112→138) was a recurring pattern across multiple defect sweeps. No remediation should proceed on a single-scan count.
permanent_prevention_rules.enforcement: Run the scan twice using independent methods. If counts differ, investigate and resolve before accepting either result.

impact_assessment.sessions_wasted: S703-S706 spent clearing items that were already structurally clean. Additional sessions spent investigating FD-045, FD-075, DL-026 Pack D Section D discrepancies.
impact_assessment.certified_items_misflagged: 67 Certified items in SESSION_STATUS flagged as defective when actually clean. Risk: items could have been decertified or queued for unnecessary remediation.
impact_assessment.root_cause_resolution: No pack file changes needed. Methodology correction only: replace forward-scan regex with Function-constructor same-object parse for all structural scan tasks.
impact_assessment.current_state: 0 Certified DL-008 items across all 5 packs (confirmed S801 Function-constructor parse). 0 DL-026 in Pack D Section D.

safe_methodology_reference.primary: Function constructor parse: eval the pack file as JavaScript, iterate array, extract CC and EW from same object.
safe_methodology_reference.secondary: Reverse-scan: find CorrectChoice first, then search BACKWARD to QuestionID (~95% reliable).
safe_methodology_reference.tertiary: String-aware brace extraction: track inString/escape, find object boundaries, extract CC and EW from same body.
safe_methodology_reference.do_not_use: Forward-scan from QuestionID to CorrectChoice. Flat regex without positional awareness. Separate CC and EW extraction passes.
